# Marky v1.8.12

Fixes the Linux AppImage failing to start when run as a different user.

### Linux

- The x86_64 AppImage shipped its launcher (`AppRun.wrapped`) as executable only by its owner. Started normally this didn't matter, but when the image was mounted by root and run by another user, as sandboxes like firejail and the AppImageHub catalog test do, it failed with "Permission denied". The launcher is now executable by everyone (#49).
